bio: Ethan Hsiao First-Year Social Committee Elm Yard Hey y’all! My name is Ethan Hsiao, and I’m from Vegas, currently living in Weld. As of now, I plan to study MCB and Government. I joined the FYSC to make our first year as memorable as possible, for all. Outside the FYSC, I love food, music, and exploring new things.
